combat_list.build_time: whole list built at the first MoveNext of the iterator; liveness filter evaluated per element at yield (Combat/CombatState.cs:928-940)

order.step: monster creature (incl. pets on the player side, e.g. Osty): creature.Monster (MonsterModel)
player relics in list order, skipping IsMelted
player potion slots in slot order, skipping null
for each pile in AllPiles = [Hand, Draw, Discard, Exhaust, Play]: each card, then its Affliction, then its Enchantment

guarded.rule: yields nothing when CombatManager.IsOverOrEnding && !IsStarting (:8794); otherwise the combat list

order: deck cards (+Enchantment, no Affliction) of every active player (:843-855)
only when childCombatState == null: relics (not melted), potions, run modifiers, badges, scaling model (:866-880)
the combat list of childCombatState, built only after the deck listeners were yielded and executed (:917-921)
run.single_player_note: in combat the deck-card listeners are inert for v0.111.0: the only card overriding a Run+Combat hook, Melancholy.AfterDeath, returns unless Pile.IsCombatPile (Models.Cards/Melancholy.cs:114-123); deck enchantments override no Run-dispatched hook

listener_order.sim_today: powers only: player powers then each Monsters[i].Powers (Combat/Pipeline/ListenerSnapshot.cs); sources Guarded/Combat/Run match the game for all 77 ported dispatchers (script check)
listener_order.should_receive_combat_hooks: AbstractModel.ShouldReceiveCombatHooks (Models/AbstractModel.cs:74) is never read by rules code: do not port it as a gate
